name: mortar
description: A WordPress-like CMS built with TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
